newsitem.title: USA: Midwest Mfg pursuing Donnelly suit.
newsitem.headline: Midwest Mfg pursuing Donnelly suit.

text.p: Midwest Manufacturing Holdings LLC said Monday it is pursuing its suit against Donnelly Corp of Holland, Mich., alleging Donnelly breached an agreement to sell its Information Products Division to Midwest.
The suit, originally filed in Cook County, Ill., Circuit Court, was shifted to the Federal District Court for Northern District of Illinois. Donnelly has said the claim is "without merit."

Midwest Manufacturing said negotations on the purchase extended from April 1996 to January 1997. It said it reached an agreement on January 17 but Donnelly changed its mind about completing the sale on January 19.
Midwest Manufacturing makes reflective glass products.
Donnelly supplies fabricated, molded and coated glas products to the automotive industry.
